purpose: A labeled set for checking that the API evaluator agrees with the in-session review loop before it replaces that loop. Image cases send the picture to three new observers. Recode cases re-code the in-session observers' stored words with the API coder, so coder agreement is measured apart from observer variance. Negative controls judge an image against another picture's contract and must fail.
development_note: These receipts' stored observations were used on 2026-09-18 to write and test the coder prompt, so agreement on their re-coding is not independent evidence. The report scores them apart from the held-out cases: the other seven re-codings and every image case, whose observers will be new.
retired_note: On 2026-09-18 the bandage card was redrawn in the tweak pass and reviewed live, and it failed on a shared misreading of its tape panel. Its labeled cases rested on the old card's in-session receipt, which no longer matches the card or its contract, so both left the set. That receipt is kept as content/reviews/anatomy/diagram.remove-dressing-v1.json, and the contract it was judged against is frozen in tests/fixtures/card-in-session.
